observations: Photo 0: Silver laptop with screen covered in plastic wrap, showing HP logo above screen. Keyboard has 'EliteBook' label on lower left. Windows key visible. Trackpad and touchpad buttons present. Intel sticker on lower right of keyboard deck. Hand holding left side.
Photo 1: Side view of laptop, still wrapped in plastic. Visible ports: USB, VGA, and possibly Ethernet. Ventilation grille on left side. Hand holding left edge.
Photo 2: Back of laptop, covered in plastic. Ventilation grille in center. Windows Pro sticker on lower left. No visible model number or serial plate. Hand holding left edge.
All photos show plastic wrap, suggesting new or recently unboxed condition. No visible damage to casing, but screen plastic is torn on top left in photo 0.
No charger or accessories shown in photos.

claims.claim: Powerful laptop for all computer related tasks
claims.evidence: No visible specs (CPU, RAM, storage, GPU) in photos. Performance cannot be assessed remotely.
No battery usage data, no indication of battery health or capacity. Cannot verify remotely.
No charger shown in any photo. Cannot confirm presence or authenticity.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of battery health via Windows battery report or a video showing battery usage and charge cycle count.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with reduced battery life

risks.risk: Laptop may be non-functional or have hidden hardware issues
risks.proof: Video showing the laptop powering on, booting to desktop, and running basic tasks.

risks.risk: Charger may be missing or non-original
risks.proof: Photo of the charger with model number and power specs, or video of it charging the laptop.

risks.risk: Screen may have dead pixels or damage under plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photo of screen with solid color (white, black, red) displayed to check for dead pixels or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen may have defects

proof_requests: Video of laptop powering on and booting to desktop.
Photo of the charger with model number and power specs.
Photo of screen displaying solid white and black to check for dead pixels.
Photo of battery health report or video showing battery usage.
response.reason: The laptop is identifiable as an HP EliteBook, but critical claims about performance, battery life, and charger authenticity cannot be verified from current photos. Hidden risks include non-functionality, degraded battery, missing charger, and screen defects. Proof is needed to assess these risks and assign a proper price.
